work.author: Catholic Church; promulgated by John Paul II
work.description: The Code of Canon Law for the Latin Church, promulgated by John Paul II by the apostolic constitution Sacrae disciplinae leges of 25 January 1983 and in force from the first day of Advent 1983 (27 November 1983). Book VI (penal law) was integrally revised by the apostolic constitution Pascite gregem Dei of 23 May 2021, effective 8 December 2021. Canon 1374 penalizes joining, promoting, or directing an association which plots against the Church without naming any association.
work.title: Codex Iuris Canonici (1983)
